```{r cars}
#Read in cpg_topsnps.text to obtain information on identifying the one TOP SNP for each CpGs
#select the 30 CpGs that are relevant
#examine the name of the columns

cpg_topsnps <-read_delim("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/Adi/cpg_topsnps.txt", 
                     delim = "\t", 
                     col_names = FALSE,
                     trim_ws = TRUE)

cpg_topsnps <- cpg_topsnps %>%
  separate(X11, into = c("pvalue", "CpG"), sep = "\\s+", extra = "merge", fill = "right") %>%
  filter(!is.na(CpG))

cpg_topsnps <- cpg_topsnps %>% rename(SNPID = X1)

allchr_rsid <- read.table(
  "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/GWAS/allchr_rsids.txt",
  header = FALSE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fill = TRUE
)
colnames(allchr_rsid) <- c("SNPID", "rsid")
allchr_rsid
cpg_topsnps

merged_cpg_topsnps<- merge(cpg_topsnps, allchr_rsid, by.x = "SNPID", by.y = "SNPID", all.x = TRUE)



```

```{r}
# List all SNP CSV files in the directory
snp_files <- list.files(
  "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/Adi/cpg_SNPs",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Read, combine, and reshape into wide format
genotype_df <- snp_files %>%
  map_df(~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
           select(pid, rsID,dosage) %>%
           pivot_wider(names_from = rsID, values_from = dosage),
         .id = NULL) %>%
  group_by(pid) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ first(na.omit(.x))), .groups = "drop")

View(genotype_df)


#read in data on cpg methylation for each pid. Make sure to only filter the 30 cpgs and also filter for white people only (based on EWAS_merged file) 
ewas_reg_outcome
pid_white <- ewas_reg_outcome %>% filter(RACEGRP51=="W") %>% select(id,RACEGRP51) #### this contains id of white participants

selected_cpgs <- c(
  "cg01409343", "cg18942579", "cg16936953", "cg12054453", "cg00490406",
  "cg01059398", "cg21979287", "cg08818207", "cg27537252", "cg03425812",
  "cg12828896", "cg03957124", "cg16306654", "cg03753191", "cg07878065",
  "cg04176813", "cg07839457", "cg16411857", "cg23387863", "cg23904266",
  "cg09249800", "cg11699125", "cg14496081", "cg07830828", "cg02068052",
  "cg24741430", "cg10636246", "cg13575798", "cg26140475", "cg09801824"
)

da.CpGs_df <- as.data.frame(da.CpGs)
da.CpGs_df <- da.CpGs_df %>% mutate(id = rownames(da.CpGs))

methylation_df <- da.CpGs_df %>%
  filter(id %in% pid_white$id) %>%
  select(id, all_of(selected_cpgs))

methylation_df <- methylation_df %>% rename(pid=id) #this is the cpg methylation matrix
merged_df <- inner_join(methylation_df, genotype_df, by = "pid")

View(merged_df)
View(merged_cpg_topsnps)

cpg_snp_map <- merged_cpg_topsnps %>%
  filter(!is.na(rsid)) %>%
  distinct(CpG, rsid) %>%
  deframe()  

```


```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

colSums(is.na(merged_df))

r2_results <- data.frame(CpG = character(), SNP = character(), R2_LM = numeric())

for (cpg in names(cpg_snp_map)) {
  snp <- cpg_snp_map[[cpg]]
  
  # Skip if either CpG or SNP missing from merged data
  if (!(cpg %in% colnames(merged_df)) || !(snp %in% colnames(merged_df))) {
    message("Skipping: ", cpg, " - missing SNP or CpG")
    next
  }
  
  df <- merged_df %>%
    select(all_of(c(cpg, snp))) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  model <- lm(df[[cpg]] ~ df[[snp]])
  r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
  
  r2_results <- rbind(r2_results, data.frame(CpG = cpg, SNP = snp, R2_LM = r2))
}

View(r2_results)

```



Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
